children: PRICES 2.5 BILLION EUROS ($2.9 billion) DUAL-TRANCHE GREEN BOND ISSUANCE
DEAL COMPRISES EUR 1.5 BILLION 7-YEAR GREEN BOND AND A EUR 1 BILLION 15-YEAR GREEN BOND.
BONDS CARRY COUPONS OF 3.375% AND 3.750% RESPECTIVELY
The 7-year bond priced at an equivalent spread of 19 bps over the reference Dutch State Loan and a spread of 15 bps over the mid-swaps curve.
The 15-year bond priced at an equivalent spread of 17 bps over the reference Dutch State Loan and a spread of 37 bps over the mid-swaps curve.
The transaction was led by a consortium of six banks, with BNP Paribas and Deutsche Bank as Global Coordinators, together with ABN AMRO, ING, HSBC, and UniCredit as Joint Lead Managers.
Green bonds are sold by issuers to raise funds for projects seen as protecting the environment, such as renewable energy.
